desktop_alt: Topmind Desktop showing the personal stream and AI chat
desktop_desc: Capture ideas, organize and write in local Markdown, and review AI suggestions before applying them.
dsh_alt: Full-page Super Kanban board with demo data
dsh_desc: Turn DSH sessions into task cards. Track progress, resolve blockers, and review deliverables on the board or in the sidebar.
handoff_desc: Carry project memory and preferences across AI tools via private Git.
handoff_step_compile: Compile shared and scenario views locally
handoff_step_git: Each tool records updates in a private Git repo
handoff_step_package: Export a portable Markdown handoff when needed
hero_lede: I explore AI / SI, technology, and knowledge, and share the workflows, methods, skills, and experiments that come out of that work. Let's compare notes.
index_presentation: Create HTML slides and editable PPTX from one source, or redesign an existing deck.
index_research: Track primary AI sources and verify facts and citations
index_writing: Write, revise, format, and create visuals for X and WeChat.
personal_desc: Replay your day on X. See posts, replies, quotes, and engagement on one dial, with music and a switcher for multiple days.
pp_beautify_alt: Before and after for three slides of an operations review: original on the left, beautified on the right
pp_beautify_cap: In each row, the original is on the left and the beautified slide is on the right.
pp_beautify_lead: The original is read-only. Before the new deck is delivered, every word, number, chart value, image and speaker note is checked against the original. Slides with several charts become dashboards or paired charts, and table plus chart becomes a half-table page.
pp_beautify_title: New layouts, not a single word changed.
pp_dense_dash_alt: Dashboard page: four key numbers, four charts and a readout row
pp_dense_dash_d: Four key numbers, four charts and a readout row, with shared colors, scales and legend.
pp_dense_focus_alt: Simple page: one large number and one line of explanation
pp_dense_focus_d: One number and one line of explanation. The rest is white space.
pp_dense_lead: From the 22-page city bus electrification review in the repository: dashboards, magazine pages and simple pages take turns, and a dense page is followed by a lighter one.
pp_dense_mag_alt: Magazine page: an illustration, a claim, two numbers and points with icons
pp_dense_mag_d: An illustration, one claim, two numbers and points with icons.
pp_dense_title: Several charts on one page, still readable at a glance.
pp_lede: Turn your material into a standalone HTML deck. Export an editable PPTX from the same source, or redesign an existing deck.
pp_meta_description: Topmind Presentation builds formal business decks: a talk, a research report, or an architecture brief. Page through HTML, export an editable PPTX when needed, with twelve styles.
pp_meta_title: Topmind Presentation — HTML slides and an editable PPTX
pp_mode_a_d: A deck for the stage, one claim per screen.
pp_mode_b_d: A research report with exhibits, sources, and takeaway bars.
pp_mode_c_d: An architecture brief built around topology, swimlane, and layered diagrams.
pp_modes_lead: The three images below are the cover slides of the sample reports in the repository.
pp_simple_alt: Four simple pages: a large number, a centered statement, an icon with text, and a single chart with a readout
pp_simple_lead: Simple pages come in 12 variants: number, statement, paragraph, icon and single chart, aligned left, centered or split. Four of them are shown below.
pp_simple_title: One number, one sentence or one icon makes a page.
pp_styles_alt: Topmind Presentation style matrix: talk, research, and architecture modes across twelve styles
pp_styles_lead: Light for sharing, dark for a big screen. Below is the matrix of three modes across twelve styles.
pp_tool_fold_d: Folds into a mini bar. The position is remembered per file.
pp_tool_full_d: Immersive presenting, with arrow keys to page.
pp_tool_help_d: Explains the two PPTX export routes and their dependencies.
pp_tool_lead: Every delivered HTML file has a toolbar at the top. Here are its buttons and keys.
pp_tool_pptx_d: Preview the page sequence and copy a prompt back into the chat to export.
pp_tool_style_d: Switch among twelve styles live. Only the look changes, never the content.
pp_tool_theme_d: Light for sharing, dark for a big screen. Remembered per file.
pp_tool_title: Shortcuts that work as soon as it opens.
pres_for: People preparing talks, research reports, or architecture briefs.
pres_note: Requires Node.js 18+ (used by the npx installer and for PPTX export). HTML uses only the Python standard library. The Release zip or git clone also work; see the README.
pres_sample_a_alt: Talk mode sample: a business-blue cover slide
pres_sample_b_alt: Research mode sample: a mckinsey-style cover slide
pres_sample_c_alt: Architecture mode sample: a graphite-dark cover slide
presentation_redesign: Before and after a slide redesign
public_desc: Enter a topic to explore its estimated activity on X over the past 24 hours. See an interactive dial, popular posts, and video with music.
recreations_alt: Optimus Prime recreated by GPT-6.2 Sol, from the Ember Signal production still
recreations_desc: Give different AI models the same recreation task and compare structure, motion, and visuals. Try the builds and explore the source and methods.
site_description: Exploring AI / SI, technology, and personal knowledge management through open workflows, methods, skills, and technical experiments.
